subject: bscf
title: (R)BSCF.------VT.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 45 (BK(NM)-21). BSCF (basic science) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-IMP (reality implications). From RT-IMP: INFO-DE (information degrees), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-DE: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: T-C-INP and INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From T-C-INP: LK-IMP (linkage implications).
